{"id":1911892014,"question_id":4213,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1770519574,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"39 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1911892014/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Merge Adjacent Equal Elements","memory":"211.4 MB","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    using ll = long long;\n    vector<long long> mergeAdjacent(vector<int>& nums) {\n        stack<ll>st;\n\n        for(int i=0 ; i<nums.size() ; i++){\n            ll curr = nums[i];\n            while(!st.empty() and st.top() == curr){\n                curr += st.top();\n                st.pop();\n            }\n            st.push(curr);\n        }\n        vector<ll>ans;\n        while(!st.empty()){\n            ans.push_back(st.top());\n            st.pop();\n        }\n        reverse(ans.begin() , ans.end());\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"merge-adjacent-equal-elements","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1666}
